product_overview: A role-based PG management web app for owners and tenants. It streamlines login, room and tenant visibility, rent payments, complaints, announcements, and tenant self-service across dedicated portals.
core_goals: Let owners and tenants sign in and reach the correct portal based on their role.
Let tenants view their allocated room, pay rent, review payment history, and manage their profile.
Let tenants submit maintenance complaints and track progress.
Let owners monitor room availability, tenants, rent status, complaints, and announcements.
Let owners manage property settings, payment verification, and occupancy/financial views.

features.name: User Authentication & Role Navigation
features.description: Users can sign in with their account credentials and be routed to the correct owner or tenant portal.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit sign in form -> See the owner dashboard based on role
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit sign in form -> See the tenant dashboard based on role
Navigate to /login -> Use demo credentials for quick access -> Submit sign in form -> See the matching dashboard based on role

features.name: Public Landing Page and Registration
features.description: Visitors can explore the public landing page and new tenants can begin the registration process.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Review property highlights, sharing options, amenities, and testimonials -> Choose to continue to sign in or registration
Navigate to /register -> Enter profile details and identity information -> Upload required documents -> Submit registration form

features.name: Owner Room Availability Grid
features.description: Owners can inspect the building layout and review bed availability across floors and rooms.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/rooms-availability -> Filter rooms by floor or sharing type -> View bed availability status across the grid -> Select a bed to inspect tenant assignment
Navigate to /owner/rooms-availability -> Filter rooms by floor or sharing type -> View rooms marked as occupied, available, or under maintenance

features.name: Owner Building Management
features.description: Owners can manage the structure and inventory of floors, rooms, and beds.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/building-structure -> Review floor, room, and bed inventory -> Update building structure and sharing configuration -> Save the revised layout

features.name: Owner Tenant Management
features.description: Owners can manage resident records, assign beds, handle pre-booking, and process checkout flows.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/tenants -> Review the tenant list -> Open new tenant onboarding -> Enter tenant details and assign a bed -> Save the tenant record
Navigate to /owner/tenants -> Review the tenant list -> Search for a resident -> Update bed assignment or pre-booking status -> Save the change
Navigate to /owner/tenants -> Review the tenant list -> Select a vacating tenant -> Complete checkout processing -> Archive the stay record

features.name: Owner Rent Management
features.description: Owners can generate rent records, track payment status, and record offline rent receipts.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/rent-management -> Review the monthly rent list -> Generate rent records for tenants -> View updated invoice statuses
Navigate to /owner/rent-management -> Review overdue rent entries -> Record an offline cash or UPI payment -> See the invoice status update

features.name: Payment Verification Queue
features.description: Owners can review manual payment proofs and approve or reject them.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/payment-verification -> Review submitted payment screenshots -> Open a proof entry -> Approve the payment submission
Navigate to /owner/payment-verification -> Review submitted payment screenshots -> Open a proof entry -> Reject the payment submission

features.name: Owner Tenant History Archive
features.description: Owners can look up previous tenants and review historical stay records.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/tenant-history -> Search the archive -> Open a previous tenant record -> Review stay dates and deposit refund information

features.name: Owner Occupancy and Financial Analytics
features.description: Owners can view charts and summaries for occupancy and revenue performance.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/occupancy-analytics -> Review occupancy charts and sharing distribution -> Compare trends over time
Navigate to /owner/financial-dashboard -> Review revenue trends and collection breakdowns -> Compare payment performance across periods

features.name: Owner Complaints Management
features.description: Owners can track tenant complaints and move tickets through resolution statuses.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/complaints -> Review open complaints -> Open a ticket -> Update its status to in progress or resolved

features.name: Owner Announcements
features.description: Owners can publish notices for tenants and remove outdated announcements.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/announcements -> Create a new announcement -> Add priority details -> Publish it for tenants to read
Navigate to /owner/announcements -> Review existing announcements -> Delete an outdated notice

features.name: Owner Settings
features.description: Owners can configure property details, rent due timing, and payment information.
user_flows: Navigate to /owner/settings -> Review property configuration -> Update rent due day, UPI QR code, or bank details -> Save the settings

features.name: Tenant Dashboard and Room Details
features.description: Tenants can review their current assignment, dues, announcements, and room information.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/dashboard -> Review current bed assignment and rent due summary -> Open recent announcements or active complaints
Navigate to /tenant/room -> Review room number, floor, roommates, and amenities

features.name: Tenant Rent Payment and Invoicing
features.description: Tenants can pay rent online or submit manual payment proof for offline UPI payments.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/payments -> Review pending rent and utility breakdown -> Pay online through the payment gateway -> See the payment marked as completed
Navigate to /tenant/payments -> Review pending rent and utility breakdown -> Upload payment proof screenshot -> Submit the proof for verification

features.name: Tenant Payment History
features.description: Tenants can review past rent transactions and access official receipts.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/payment-history -> Review past payment entries -> Open a receipt for a transaction -> Download the official receipt

features.name: Tenant Complaints Management
features.description: Tenants can file maintenance complaints with attachments and track resolution progress.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/complaints -> Start a new complaint -> Enter category, title, and description -> Attach an optional image -> Submit the complaint -> See the live status tracker
Navigate to /tenant/complaints -> Review an existing complaint -> Check its current resolution status

features.name: Tenant Announcements
features.description: Tenants can read property-wide notices and manager updates.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/announcements -> Review the notice board -> Open an announcement to read the full message

features.name: Tenant Profile Management
features.description: Tenants can update their personal contact details, emergency contacts, and documents.
user_flows: Navigate to /tenant/profile -> Review saved personal details and documents -> Update contact information or emergency phone numbers -> Save the profile changes

routes.description: Public landing page showcasing PG features, room sharing types, amenities, and CTA to login/register.
Unified login page supporting owner and tenant login via email/password or phone OTP.
Tenant registration page with document uploads and profile details.
Owner control center with occupancy stats, revenue metrics, emergency tenant search, and quick actions.
Interactive floor-by-floor visual bed grid with status indicators and allocation actions.
Building floor, room, and bed inventory management.
Tenant records, onboarding, bed assignments, pre-booking, and checkout processing.
Monthly rent billing generator, overdue tracking, and offline payment recording.
Manual payment screenshot verification queue with approval/rejection actions.
Historical archive of vacated tenants and previous stay records.
Visual charts depicting room occupancy rates, sharing distribution, and trends.
Financial metrics, revenue trends, and rent collection breakdowns.
Ticket management board for tenant complaints with status update workflows.
Community announcement broadcasting and deletion manager.
Property configuration, rent due day settings, UPI QR code, and bank details.
Tenant portal dashboard with current bed info, monthly rent dues, and quick actions.
View allocated room, floor, roommates, and amenities.
Pay monthly rent online via Razorpay or upload manual UPI screenshot proofs.
View past rent payment transactions and download official receipts.
Report maintenance issues with photo attachments and track resolution status.
View property-wide notice board and manager announcements.
Manage personal details, emergency contacts, and documents.

features.name: User Authentication & Role Navigation
features.description: Login with credentials (owner@pgmaster.com / admin123 or tenant credentials), session persistence, and automatic routing
user_interactions: Toggle demo credentials for quick login
Redirect to Owner or Tenant dashboard based on role

features.name: Owner Room Availability Grid
features.description: Interactive visualization of all floors, rooms, and bed statuses with instant search and filter
user_interactions: Filter rooms by sharing type or floor
View bed cards with occupied/available status chips
Click on bed to inspect or assign tenant

features.name: Tenant Rent Payment & Invoicing
features.description: Tenant monthly rent checkout with Razorpay online gateway and offline UPI proof submission
user_interactions: View breakdown of pending rent and utility dues
Click Pay Online to open Razorpay modal
Alternatively click Upload Payment Proof to submit screenshot

features.name: Complaints & Maintenance System
features.description: Tenants report issues and owners update status
user_interactions: Fill category, title, description and attach optional image
Submit complaint ticket and view live progress tracker
